scripts.clean: turbo run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/web/.next')) fs.rmSync('apps/web/.next', {recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.free: powershell -Command "try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5238 -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"
